A command buffer handle names an immutable package. nvn_command_package{handle,records,bytes,record_count} comes out of nvn_command_buffer_get_package(); recording the same buffer again, finalizing it or reusing the address does not overwrite the old package, and an unknown handle is refused. The data behind a pointer argument is copied during the call. The copied bytes counter counts every copy the call made, the payload copies included. honor_render_root_cause.summary: The final presented game image carries alpha=0 for 92.1% of pixels while RGB holds the full picture. The blit into the swapchain preserves that alpha, and the swapchain is created with VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_INHERIT_BIT_KHR with no native window blending mode set, so the Honor compositor honours the alpha and multiplies the world away. Only the top-right mini-map/HUD has alpha!=0, so only it survives.
